target_validity.pass: The implementation targets M=1, K=1024, N=3072 decode-only up_proj with Half activation, Half weight, and Half output, matching the 28-layer shape audit.
target_validity.fail: Any change to operator, shape family, decode scope, operand dtype, output dtype, or target path without a new authorized artifact.

correctness.pass: All required finite, shape, guard, CUDA, and max_abs_error checks satisfy the inherited Exp04 gate atol=1e-3 and rtol=1e-4.
correctness.fail: Any non-finite output, shape mismatch, guard failure, CUDA failure, or tolerance violation.

microbenchmark_performance.pass: The custom path median latency is lower than the measured existing-path baseline median, with a 95% confidence interval for the paired or suitably controlled latency difference excluding zero.
microbenchmark_performance.fail: The confidence interval includes zero or favors the existing path.
microbenchmark_performance.note: No percentage threshold is invented in Phase 4-C because a pure per-call baseline has not yet been measured.

measurement_stability.pass: At least seven independent trials per path, stable CUDA Event windows, and reported CV; transient DVFS or outlier trials are investigated rather than silently discarded.
measurement_stability.fail: Fewer than seven trials, missing statistics, or unexplained instability that prevents a repeatable comparison.

runtime_integration.pass: After explicit integration authorization, same-session persistent-runtime decode comparison shows no end-to-end decode regression with confidence bounds excluding a regression.
runtime_integration.fail: Microbenchmark improvement only, or end-to-end decode latency regression.
runtime_integration.note: The persistent Mixed baseline is S=8 TPOT median 43.411762 ms with CV 9.1713% and S=16 TPOT median 43.173353 ms with CV 0.7028% under the Phase 3-C protocol.

overall_optimization_claim.not_proven_when: Only correctness passes, only the microbenchmark passes, or runtime integration is untested.
